split_recomputed.limitation: Exact-text grouping only; shared articles, excerpts and paraphrases may still overlap.

scope_of_code_review.train: Reads prepared train.jsonl from author sample. Queue warmup/keys and fixed-teacher inputs use that train split.
scope_of_code_review.evaluation: SciFact title+text, queries and qrels; custom binary metrics. Qrels are not used in training objective.
scope_of_code_review.demo: Exact retrieval from SciFact corpus; no web-search or LLM context-generation call in reviewed live_retrieval_demo.py.
scope_of_code_review.declared_external_dependencies: Pretrained facebook/contriever and tokenizer, author sample, official BEIR SciFact distribution; KD references support the extension only.
scope_of_code_review.limits: Static code/data/hash audit plus exported evidence, not a new GPU training reproduction. Cannot audit complete pretrained data or exclude semantic/article overlap. SciFact-aware design bias remains.

validation_this_revision.unit_tests: 14 tests passed in the terminal during this revision.

result_verifier.checkpoint_note: Hashes agree between train and evaluation records; actual large checkpoint files not independently downloaded here.
result_verifier.limit: Confirms exported metrics and protocol; not independent reproduction of training or temporal gold evaluation.
result_verifier.live_inference_evidence: Four live runs match saved top3 and corpus/checkpoint hashes; checkpoint hashes were computed in the separate GPU inference job.
